articles.title: Bede Liu, pioneer in digital signal processing and beloved mentor, dies at age 91
articles.summary: Bede Liu, an emeritus professor of electrical engineering and a pioneering figure in digital signal processing, passed away on May 7 at 91. His groundbreaking research was instrumental in facilitating the crucial transition from analog to digital technologies, leaving a lasting impact on numerous fields. His contributions significantly advanced modern digital systems.

articles.title: Goa schools get a space science boost from Isro
articles.summary: ISRO is actively boosting space science education in Goa schools, aiming to ignite students' interest in space technology and scientific research. This initiative is crucial for fostering future talent in India's growing space sector and aligns with national goals for scientific and technological advancement. Such programs involve workshops, curriculum enrichment, and resource provision, preparing young minds for careers in science and space exploration.

articles.title: La Ronge, Sask., sees record number of high school graduates
articles.summary: Talus Hryniuk is set to achieve a significant family milestone, becoming the first male in his lineage to graduate high school. Expressing nervousness for the big day, he underscored the immense personal importance of completing his education. This achievement highlights the value of perseverance and marks a proud moment, demonstrating the impact of individual determination on familial progression and setting a new precedent.

articles.title: Deadly ‘Omega’ heat wave cooking Europe expected to shatter more records
articles.summary: Western Europe experienced a record-shattering heat wave Wednesday, causing widespread disruptions and tragic losses. Dozens died from extreme temperatures; schools closed, and power outages impacted communities. The severe weather also devastated agricultural sectors, notably wiping out poultry. This event highlights escalating challenges climate change presents to public health and critical infrastructure internationally.
